thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning to enable model v7 for a narrow audience today.
          Rolling slices: v7-eu @ 12:30 UTC -> 10%, v7-apac @ 13:00 UTC -> 5%.
          Guardrails: auto cutoff if 5xx rate > 1% for 5m or p50 latency +40% vs baseline.

lucas: LGTM. What's the observable we'll use for "latency"? p50 or p95?

maria: p50 for fast detection, and p95 for sustained degradation. config below.

maria: ```
rollout: v7
slices:
  - name: v7-eu
    region: eu
    pct: 10
    auto_cutoffs:
      - metric: http_5xx_rate
        threshold: 0.01
        window: 300
      - metric: p50_latency_ratio
        threshold: 1.4
        window: 120
  - name: v7-apac
    region: apac
    pct: 5
```

sam: Please add an immediate fallback to v6 for those slices if cutoff triggers. Also ensure cache warming on v7 nodes so tail latencies don't spike.

anika: Oncall heads-up: @oncall will get alert if either cutoff hits. Can we add a soft-notify first (pager only after 2 cutoffs)?

maria: Yes — plan is soft-notify to #eng-oncall + escalate to pager after repeat cutoff within 10m. I'm adding that rule now.

lucas: Small nit: use "p50_latency_ratio" calculation to compare to a rolling baseline from last 24h. Otherwise noisy.

maria: Good call — switched to 24h rolling baseline.

deploy-bot: feature-flag-service: flag "model_v7" updated -> slices: [v7-eu:10%, v7-apac:5%] by maria

anika: Also reminder: keep the EU legal/reg set in mind — no user-level logging for those slices. Confirm kms scope is correct.

maria: Confirmed. KMS scope restricted. No PII shipped to logs.

sam: Code-review ping: I left a small comment on the rollout config PR about a retry backoff on the cache-warming job.

maria: Thanks — merging after PR green and a quick e2e smoketest. Will post results here.

lucas: If anything looks off, call the abort: `infra toggle disable model_v7 --reason"regressions"`

maria: Noted. Starting at 12:30 UTC. I'll update when slices are live. :rocket:
